name: Conkers
description: Two phones, two conkers, one swing at a time. A conker is a nut cell and a string cell, both LINEAR, locked in a BSV UTXO under SIGHASH_NONE|ANYONECANPAY|CHRONICLE. Properties derive from a hash chain over a fixed issuer signature (spec/genesis.md). Damage is settled by the match record both players sign; the chain enforces that each conker is consumed once per match.

cellTypes.name: conkers.nut
cellTypes.description: The nut: serial, genesis pair id, mass, volume, hardness, elasticity, owner, hp, wins, losses. LINEAR so a nut is struck once per match and cannot be duplicated or dropped.

cellTypes.name: conkers.string
cellTypes.description: The string: serial, genesis pair id, length, strength, elasticity, owner, intact. LINEAR for the same reason as the nut; a snapped string is a cell whose successor has intact=false.

cellTypes.name: conkers.player
cellTypes.description: A person's record, keyed by cert-id: challenges, withdrawals, stalls. Lives on the player, never on a conker, so selling a conker does not launder a flincher.

cellTypes.name: conkers.swing
cellTypes.description: One turn: striker IMU trace summary, target Doppler reading, score, damage. Signed by both phones. Never persisted beyond the match.

cellTypes.name: conkers.withdraw
cellTypes.description: The target pulled away, or the striker never swung (stall). Signed by both phones or ruled by the arbiter.

cellTypes.name: conkers.match
cellTypes.description: The match: both nonces exchanged over ggwave (co-location proof), the turn list, final damage, winner. Both players sign, the arbiter countersigns. What resolve consumes.

capabilities.name: cap.conkers.play
capabilities.description: Authorises mint / pair / swing / withdraw / resolve / transfer.

_notes.domainFlag: 0 is a placeholder until a capability page is allocated.
_notes.sighash: 0xA2 = NONE|ANYONECANPAY|CHRONICLE. OTDA digest. See docs/PLAN.md 'The lock'.
_notes.extension: Shape follows vendor/semantos-core/docs/design/WORLD-BASE-LAYER.md §5.1; the client contract is packages/world-client/src/extension.ts.
